items.originalTitle: We are deeply saddened by the passing of Alan Jones. A true Williams legend, Alan formed an extraordinary bond with Frank Williams and Patrick Head an...
items.summaryEn:
We are deeply saddened by the passing of Alan Jones.
A true Williams legend, Alan formed an extraordinary bond with Frank Williams and Patrick Head and made history by winning our first Drivers’ World Championship in 1980. 
He set the standard for Williams champions: a fast, uncompromising racer with a challenger mentality who loved motor racing and dedicated his life to it.
He will be dearly missed, and we send our love and thoughts to his family and friends.
detailZh:
我们深感悲痛地宣布艾伦·琼斯的逝世。
艾伦·琼斯是威廉姆斯车队真正的传奇人物，他与弗兰克·威廉姆斯和帕特里克·海德建立了非凡的联系，并在1980年赢得了我们首个车手世界冠军。
他树立了威廉姆斯车队冠军的标准：一个快速、坚定不移的赛车手，具有挑战者心态，热爱赛车，并将一生奉献给了这项运动。
我们将永远怀念他，并向他的家人和朋友致以我们的爱和思念。
detailEn:
We are deeply saddened by the passing of Alan Jones.
A true Williams legend, Alan formed an extraordinary bond with Frank Williams and Patrick Head and made history by winning our first Drivers’ World Championship in 1980. 
He set the standard for Williams champions: a fast, uncompromising racer with a challenger mentality who loved motor racing and dedicated his life to it.
He will be dearly missed, and we send our love and thoughts to his family and friends.

items.originalTitle: Former F1 world champion Jones dies aged 80
detailZh: 前F1世界冠军艾伦·琼斯因短期疾病逝世，享年80岁。
艾伦·琼斯是最后一位赢得F1车手总冠军的澳大利亚人；他在1980年为威廉姆斯车队夺冠。
艾伦·琼斯在其F1生涯中赢得了12场大奖赛。
琼斯因短期疾病逝世的消息由琼斯家族通过澳大利亚赛车运动协会发布。
琼斯是继杰克·布拉汉姆爵士之后，第二位赢得世界冠军的澳大利亚人，在他的职业生涯中，他在12场大奖赛中登上了领奖台，期间曾效力于Hesketh、威廉姆斯（他与威廉姆斯车队赢得了他的冠军）和Arrows车队。
哀悼艾伦·琼斯。
澳大利亚大奖赛公司怀着极大的悲痛宣布艾伦·琼斯的去世，并向他的家人、亲人和朋友表示最深切的同情。
作为一级方程式世界冠军和澳大利亚最伟大的赛车…… pic.twitter.com/R79Pkk3rhY
— 2026年11月5日 F1澳大利亚大奖赛 (@ausgrandprix) 发布
您可以在任何时间通过隐私选项更改您的设置。
“我们非常悲痛地宣布，我们深爱的艾伦于11月5日因短期疾病去世，”他的妻子阿曼达·巴特勒-戴维斯说。
“他将被那些与他最亲近的人以及一直支持他的众多粉丝深深怀念。”
"艾伦将一生奉献给了赛车运动，他留下的遗产将通过他沿途所触及的无数人继续传承。"
“通过他的成就、激情和无可置疑的性格，无论是在赛道上还是赛道外，艾伦都在国内外体育界留下了持久的印记。”
“作为一家人，我们想借此机会感谢所有在艾伦的旅程中陪伴他多年的朋友、爱和支持。他非常幸运，身边有这么多美好的人。”
“琼斯身后留下了他的妻子和六个孩子。”

detailEn: Former Formula 1 world champion Alan Jones dies aged 80
Alan Jones remains the last Australian to win the F1 drivers' championship; he triumphed in 1980 while racing for Williams; Jones won 12 grands prix across his F1 career
Former Formula 1 world champion Alan Jones has died at the age of 80 following a brief illness.
A statement from Jones' family, issued through Motorsport Australia, announced the death of the 1980 championship winner - who remains the last Australian to win the F1 title.

Jones was only the second Australian to win the championship after Sir Jack Brabham, and topped the podium at 12 grands prix during a career that took in spells with Hesketh, Williams - with whom he won his title - and Arrows.
Vale Alan Jones.
It is with great sadness that the Australian Grand Prix Corporation acknowledges the passing of Alan Jones, and we extend our deepest sympathies to his family, loved ones and friends.
As a Formula 1® World Champion and one of Australia’s greatest racing… pic.twitter.com/R79Pkk3rhY
— F1 Australian Grand Prix (@ausgrandprix) November 5, 2026
You can change your settings at any time via the Privacy Options.
"We are extremely saddened to announce the passing of our beloved Alan, who passed away on November 5 following a short illness," his wife Amanda Butler-Davis said.
"He will be dearly missed and fondly remembered by those closest to him, as well as the many fans whose support he was always grateful for.
"Alan dedicated his life to motorsport, building a legacy that will live on through the countless people he touched along the way.
"Through his achievements, passion and unmistakable character, both on and off the track, Alan left an enduring mark on the sport both nationally and across the globe.

"As a family, we would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who was part of Alan's journey for the many years of friendship, love and support. He was incredibly fortunate to have so many wonderful people around him."
Jones is survived by his wife and six children.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen brings “some samba” to Sao Paulo with Brazil-themed F1 helmet
detailZh: 维斯塔潘带来了一些桑巴舞的气氛到圣保罗，他在Instagram上分享了自己为这场比赛设计的特别头盔。
这位红牛车手在本周末的Interlagos赛道比赛中，将换上巴西国旗的颜色。
对于红牛车迷来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和比赛分析。
维斯塔潘将在本周末的圣保罗大奖赛中身着巴西国旗颜色参赛，并在Instagram上展示了这款特别头盔。
红牛车手将他的常用红、白、蓝涂装换成了巴西国旗上的绿、黄、蓝，并在Instagram上分享了这一设计，并配文：“为圣保罗带来一些桑巴。”
这并不是他第一次用新的头盔设计来庆祝这场比赛。去年圣保罗的头盔在他的常用狮子图案上增加了金色和绿色的点缀，当时维斯塔潘将这场比赛描述为“特别”的。
这有很多原因。他的伴侣凯莉·皮奎特是三届世界冠军内尔森·皮奎特的女儿。再加上，他还把奥迪的巴西车手加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托视为亲密的朋友。
这条赛道也给他职业生涯中留下了许多难忘的时刻。
在2016年，他只在F1的第二赛季，尽管在比赛还剩16圈时排名第16，但在一场雨战中他最终获得了第三名，这是他能力的一次展示。
自那以后，他在Interlagos赢得了三次比赛，分别是2019年、2023年和2024年。其中最后一次被认为是他职业生涯中最伟大的驾驶之一。他在大雨中从第17位发车，数月来首次获胜，并且离他的第四个世界冠军更近了一步。
甚至在去年，他从维修区起步，最终攀升至第三名，仅落后于第二名的小车手安东内利不到半秒。
今年，随着维斯塔潘在墨西哥上周末获胜，他取得了在该赛事中的第六次胜利，来到这里。安东内利已经锁定了冠军，但如果在维斯塔潘经常表现出色的赛道上获胜，这将是一个强劲的结果，可以带入赛季的最后几轮。
他不是唯一一个在本周末改变赛车服设计的车手。安东内利也将佩戴一款特别的头盔，以纪念埃尔顿·塞纳，而他本人和乔治·拉塞尔在本周末将身穿紫色赛车服代表梅赛德斯。
detailEn: Max Verstappen brings “some samba” to Sao Paulo with Brazil-themed F1 helmet
The Red Bull driver has swapped his usual colours for those of the Brazilian flag ahead of this weekend’s race at Interlagos
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Max Verstappen will race in the colours of Brazil at this weekend’s Sao Paulo Grand Prix after revealing a special helmet for the race.

The Red Bull driver has replaced his usual red, white and blue with the green, yellow and blue of the Brazilian flag, sharing the design on Instagram alongside the following caption: “Bringing some samba to São Paulo."

It is not the first time he's celebrated this race with a new helmet design. Last year’s Sao Paulo helmet added gold and green accents to his usual lion motif, with Verstappen describing the race as “special” at the time.

There are plenty of reasons for that. His partner, Kelly Piquet, is the daughter of three-time world champion Nelson Piquet. To add to this, he counts Audi’s Brazilian driver Gabriel Bortoleto as a close friend.
The circuit has also provided some of the most memorable moments of his career.
In 2016, in only his second season in F1, he finished third in the wet despite being 16th with 16 laps to go, in one of the first races to show what he was capable of.

He has since won at Interlagos three times, in 2019, 2023 and 2024. The last of those is often regarded as one of the greatest drives of his career. He started 17th in heavy rain, won for the first time in months and moved much closer to his fourth world title.
Even last year, when he started from the pitlane, he climbed to third, finishing less than half a second behind a young Kimi Antonelli in second.

This year’s visit comes with Verstappen in good form, having won in Mexico last weekend to take his sixth victory in that race. Antonelli has already clinched the title, but a win at a track where Verstappen has so often excelled would be another strong result to take into the final rounds of the season.

He is not the only driver changing the design of his racing suit for this coming weekend. Antonelli will also wear a special helmet as a tribute to Ayrton Senna, while he and George Russell will wear purple suits for Mercedes across the weekend.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli to honour Ayrton Senna with special helmet at Brazilian GP
detailZh: 安东内利将在巴西大奖赛上佩戴特别头盔纪念塞纳
新晋F1世界冠军安东内利将在巴西大奖赛上佩戴特别头盔，以纪念他的赛车英雄塞纳。
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
安东内利将在本周末作为2026年世界冠军抵达Interlagos赛道，并计划利用这个机会向他的赛车英雄塞纳致敬。
梅赛德斯车手确认他将在巴西大奖赛上佩戴一顶特别的头盔，以纪念塞纳，纪念这位巴西车手首次在家乡赢得比赛以来的35年。
"我将为巴西准备一顶特别头盔，为了埃伊尔顿，" 安东内利在墨西哥对媒体说。
"也因为这将是他第一次在第六档赢得家乡比赛的35周年。所以，是的，这将是一顶为巴西、为埃伊尔顿的纪念头盔，我认为这是我制作过的最好的头盔之一。
““所以，希望你们大家，希望你们会喜欢它。但是，是的，这将是一个非常特别的周末。我非常期待它，因为巴西的支持一直很棒，不仅今年如此，去年也是如此。”"
“是的，我期待着回到那里，希望这将是一个美好的周末。”
安东内利在父亲的陪伴下，通过DVD观看旧F1赛事长大，去年他对媒体表示，塞纳是所有车手中最突出的一个。他也以12号车手身份在莲花车队和1988年他在麦克拉伦车队赢得第一个冠军赛季中参赛。
成为自那时以来首位以那个车号赢得冠军的车手后，他将保持12号车号至2027年，而不是换成1号。
“我认为我会继续使用12号，”安东内利在墨西哥对媒体说，“我会继续使用12号，因为显然，这个号码对我来说非常特别。”
他补充说：“这也是我保持谦逊、脚踏实地的一种方式。我觉得保持12号让我有一个新的起点，再次从头开始，并努力做得更好。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli to honour Ayrton Senna with special helmet at Brazilian GP
Newly crowned Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli will honour Ayrton Senna with a special helmet at the Brazilian Grand Prix
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Kimi Antonelli will arrive at Interlagos as the 2026 world champion this weekend, and he plans to use the occasion to pay tribute to his racing hero, Ayrton Senna.
The Mercedes driver has confirmed he will wear a special helmet at the Brazilian Grand Prix in honour of Senna, marking 35 years since the Brazilian driver won his home race for the first time.
"I will have a special helmet for Brazil, for Ayrton," Antonelli told the media in Mexico.

"Also because it’s going to be 35 years since he won in sixth gear, his home race. So, yeah, it’s going to be a tribute helmet for Brazil, for Ayrton, and I think it’s one of my best helmets that I’ve made.

“So hopefully you guys, everyone, hopefully you will like it. But, yeah, it’s going to be a very special weekend. I’m very much looking forward to it because the support from Brazil in general has been incredible, not only this year but already from last year.
“So, yeah, looking forward to going back there, and hopefully it’s going to be a great weekend."

Antonelli grew up watching old F1 races on DVD with his father and told the media last year that Senna "was the driver who stood out among them all". He also races with the number 12 that Senna used at Lotus and in his first title-winning season at McLaren in 1988.
Having become the first driver to win the championship with that race number since then, he will keep it for 2027 instead of switching to number 1.
"I think I'll stay with number 12," Antonelli told the media in Mexico. "I'll stay with number 12 because, obviously, it's a very special number for me."

He added: "It's also a way for me to stay grounded, to stay humble. I feel like keeping number 12 allows me to have a new point where to start and to build on everything again and try to improve more."

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli shares "unforgettable" Ayrton Senna moment after F1 title win
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在赢得一级方程式冠军后分享了“难忘”的阿yrton Senna时刻
新晋一级方程式冠军基米·安东内利访问了阿yrton Senna在巴西的家庭庄园
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
2026年一级方程式冠军基米·安东内利从赢得他的首个冠军到坐在他英雄的赛车中，仅用了两天时间。
梅赛德斯车手，上周末在墨西哥大奖赛中夺得冠军，周二在巴西大奖赛之前参观了塞纳家族的家。他分享了自己在传奇的黑白Lotus 98T赛车驾驶舱中的照片，这位三届冠军在1986年驾驶这辆车。
“难忘的一天。感谢整个塞纳家族。这些记忆需要一段时间才能沉淀，但我将永远带着它们。”安东内利在Instagram上发文。
这位意大利人在他的父亲马可、塞纳的侄子布鲁诺和侄女们布鲁娜和拉拉利陪同下参观了位于塔图伊的Fazenda Dois Lagos庄园。这个地产有自己的卡丁车赛道，建于1991年，安东内利似乎充分利用了它。前F1车手布鲁诺·塞纳在安东内利的帖子下评论道：“感谢你的卡丁车课程，冠军！”
安东内利并不是第一个访问这个庄园的F1冠军，七届冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿也在2022年因特拉戈斯站的比赛之前访问过这个地产。
安东内利之前曾谈到他对塞纳的钦佩。在2025年巴西大奖赛之前，他被发现在莫伦比公墓巴西人的墓前坐着。
“那是一次真的很酷的经历，”安东内利当时对媒体解释道。‘阿yrton是我的赛车英雄。昨天我有很多空闲时间，所以我想，为什么不呢？那离我的酒店很近。’
“所以我决定去一次。我决定早上去，但后来我也下午去了，因为我觉得那是一个很安静的地方，非常平和。所以这次下午，我决定和我的教练一起去那里，我们读了一本书。我们在一个安静的地方读书，只是在那里度过了一些平和的时光，真的很棒。但是的，我真的很想去看他。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli shares "unforgettable" Ayrton Senna moment after F1 title win
Newly crowned Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli visited Ayrton Senna's family estate in Brazil
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
2026 Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli went from winning his maiden title to sitting in his hero's car in the space of two days.

The Mercedes driver, who clinched the title at the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend, visited Ayrton Senna's family home on Tuesday ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix. He shared a photo of himself in the cockpit of the iconic black and gold Lotus 98T that the three-time champion raced in 1986.
"Unforgettable day. Obrigado to the whole Senna family. It will take some time to sink in, but I will carry these memories with me forever," Antonelli posted on Instagram.

The Italian was joined by his father, Marco, and Senna's nephew and nieces, Bruno, Bianca and Lalalli Senna, when he visited the Fazenda Dois Lagos estate in Tatuí. The property has its own kart track, opened in 1991, and Antonelli seems to have made the most of it. Bruno Senna, a former F1 driver himself, commented on Antonelli's post: "Thank you for the karting lesson, Champ!"
Antonelli is not the first F1 champion to make the trip to the estate, with seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton also visiting the property before the race at Interlagos in 2022.
Antonelli has previously spoken about his admiration for Senna. He was spotted sitting by the Brazilian's grave in the Morumbi Cemetery ahead of the 2025 Brazilian Grand Prix.

"It was a really cool experience," Antonelli explained to the media at the time. "Ayrton is my racing hero. And yesterday I had a lot of time on hand, so I said, you know, why not? It was very close to my hotel.

"So I decided to go once. I decided to go in the morning, but then I also went in the afternoon because I found it a really quiet place, very peaceful. So in the afternoon, I decided to go there this time with my coach, and we read a book. We were reading a book and just spent some time in peace in a quiet place and it was really nice. But yeah, I really wanted to go and say hi to him."

items.originalTitle: Mercedes to race in new suits at Brazil GP in nod to legendary era
detailZh: 梅赛德斯将在巴西大奖赛中穿着新赛车服，向传奇时代致敬。
世界冠军安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔将在整个周末的Interlagos赛事中穿着这款特殊设计的赛车服，这是本赛季车队第二次穿上紫色赛车服。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·安东内利，梅赛德斯。
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里有最新的银箭消息，包括来自Brackley和Brixworth的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和赛事分析。
梅赛德斯车队在本周末的圣保罗大奖赛上看起来会有一些不同，世界冠军基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔将换上紫色的赛车服，而不是他们通常的黑色和蓝色赛车服。
这款设计于周二在圣保罗的Nubank公园揭晓，这是帕尔梅拉斯足球俱乐部的主场，作为车队与巴西银行Nubank合作的一部分。两位车手将在整个周末的各节练习与排位中穿着这套赛车服。
“受过去启发，为未来打造。欢迎来到新纪元，”安东内利在Instagram上写道。“这个周末的新形象！”
这套赛车服由梅赛德斯设计，灵感来源于20世纪80年代和90年代，那是纳尔逊·皮克特和埃尔顿·塞纳赢得他们冠军头衔的时期。这次活动的口号是“受黄金时代启发，为新时代打造”。
两种色调都来自银行。深色基调取自其高端卡Ultravioleta，而较浅的紫色代表其最大的客户群。
这个揭晓伴随着一部介绍两位车手的电影，由在Netflix关于三届冠军的系列剧中扮演塞纳的加布里埃尔·莱昂担任旁白。其配乐是Tema da Vitoria，这是当巴西车手在F1中获胜时，TV Globo播放的音乐，与塞纳的职业生涯紧密相连。
这是梅赛德斯在2026年的第二次这样做。在5月的迈阿密大奖赛上，车队使用了三种不同的紫色西装，每种设计都与Nubank的扩张有关，安东内利随后赢得了那场比赛。
梅赛德斯市场运营主管维多利亚·约翰逊表示，对那些西装的反应让车队兴奋地想在圣保罗更进一步。
“与Nu的合作基于寻找大胆而有意义的方式将粉丝更紧密地与我们团队联系在一起。紫色的赛车服是这种雄心的绝佳表达，将Nu的独特身份与我们自己的身份相结合，同时庆祝巴西对一级方程式的无限热情。在今年早些时候在迈阿密的紫色赛车服反应之后，我们很兴奋在圣保罗更进一步地实现这一概念，为赛季中最具激情的周末之一创造一些独特的东西。”
Nubank联合创始人克里斯蒂娜·茹涅拉补充说：“圣保罗大奖赛对巴西人、对Nubank、对梅赛德斯-AMG PETRONAS F1车队车手来说都是一场特别的比赛，因为它发生在该银行成立的城市。”
这些赛车服也将在Nubank House展出，这是一场为该银行客户举办的免费展览，在体育场进行，直到周日。展览还包括一辆W17的复制品和2021年刘易斯·汉密尔顿穿过的赛车服。
Nubank表示，巴西对一级方程式的兴趣正在迅速增长。它使用Ibope数据表示，2026年的前10场比赛在该国吸引了5280万人观看，已经超过了2025年整个赛季的观众人数。”
梅赛德斯车队如果周日一切顺利，将不仅仅因为新形象而庆祝，因为它可以在英特拉戈斯赛道结束车队 constructors’ championship 的争夺。
detailEn: Mercedes to race in new suits at Brazil GP in nod to legendary era
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell will wear the special design all weekend at Interlagos, the second time this season the team has gone purple
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Mercedes team will look a little different at this weekend’s Sao Paulo Grand Prix, with world champion Kimi Antonelli and George Russell switching to purple race suits instead of their usual black and turquoise.

The design was revealed on Tuesday at the Nubank Parque in Sao Paulo, the stadium of football club Palmeiras, as part of the team’s partnership with Brazilian bank Nubank. Both drivers will wear the suits in all sessions of the race weekend.
“Inspired by the past. Built for the New. Welcome, to the Nu Era,” Antonelli wrote on Instagram. “New look for this weekend!”

Designed by Mercedes, the suits borrow from those worn in the 1980s and 1990s, the period when Nelson Piquet and Ayrton Senna won their titles. The campaign’s slogan is “Inspired by the Golden Era, Built for the New Era”.
The two shades both come from the bank. The dark base is taken from Ultravioleta, its premium card, and the lighter purple represents its largest customer base.

The reveal came with a film featuring both drivers, narrated by Gabriel Leone, who played Senna in Netflix’s series about the three-time champion. Its soundtrack is the Tema da Vitoria, the music that TV Globo played when Brazilian drivers won in F1, and which is closely tied to Senna’s career.

It is the second time Mercedes has done this in 2026. At the Miami Grand Prix in May, the team used three different purple suits, one for each day of the weekend, with each design carrying coordinates connected to Nubank’s expansion. Antonelli went on to win that race.
Victoria Johnson, Mercedes’ marketing operations chief, said the reaction to those suits made the team excited to take the idea further in Sao Paulo.

“The partnership with Nu is based on finding bold and meaningful ways to bring fans closer to our team. The purple race suits are an excellent expression of that ambition, uniting Nu’s unmistakable identity with our own while celebrating the incredible passion Brazil has for Formula 1. After the reaction to our purple suits in Miami earlier this year, it is exciting to take this concept even further in Sao Paulo and create something unique for one of the most passionate race weekends of the season.”

Nubank co-founder Cristina Junqueira added: “The Sao Paulo Grand Prix is a special round for Brazilians, for Nubank, because it takes place in the city where it was founded, and for the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team drivers.”

The suits will also be on show at the Nubank House, a free exhibition for the bank’s customers running at the stadium until Sunday. It also includes a replica W17 and a suit worn by Lewis Hamilton in 2021.

Nubank says interest in F1 is growing quickly in Brazil. Using Ibope data, it said the first 10 races of 2026 reached 52.8 million people in the country, already more than the whole of the 2025 season.
Mercedes will have more to celebrate than a new look if things go its way on Sunday, as it can wrap up the constructors’ championship at Interlagos.
